destination.name: Zhenjiang
destination.tagline: Yangtze ferry-crossing city of famed temple hills, a preserved old quarter and black vinegar.
destination.description: Zhenjiang sits where the Grand Canal meets the Yangtze, across the river from Yangzhou, and was long an important trading stop. Its hill parks, Jinshan, Jiaoshan, Beigu and Nanshan, each carry a temple, pagoda or legend. The Xijindu ferry quarter and the British-era consulate buildings on Yuntai Mountain date from its time as a treaty port. The city is also known for its vinegar, served with steamed dumplings.
whyVisit: Climb temple hills above the Yangtze
Walk a preserved old ferry quarter

goodToKnow.title: Hill park tickets add up
goodToKnow.detail: Each hill park charges about ¥30 to ¥65, and climbing a pagoda costs roughly ¥10 more. Fees are higher in spring and autumn.

goodToKnow.title: Leave Jiaoshan on time
goodToKnow.detail: Jiaoshan is an island reached by boat, and the last ferry off leaves between 17:00 and 18:00 depending on the season.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Mild days in {months} suit climbing the hill parks, before summer turns hot and wet.
